argv:
set -euo pipefail
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
WORK=/tmp/integral_v2
RESULT="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/agent-runtime/results/integral-3b1b-v2"
rm -rf "$WORK" "$RESULT"; mkdir -p "$WORK/refs" "$RESULT"; cd "$WORK"
echo '[1/8] dependencies'
sudo apt-get update -qq
sudo apt-get install -y -qq ffmpeg libcairo2-dev libpango1.0-dev pkg-config python3-dev espeak-ng texlive-latex-base texlive-latex-extra texlive-fonts-recommended dvisvgm >/tmp/apt.log
python3 -m pip install -q --upgrade pip
python3 -m pip install -q 'manim==0.19.0' kokoro-onnx soundfile yt-dlp

echo '[2/8] yt-dlp reference video + screenshots'
REF_URL='https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rfG8ce4nNh0'
set +e
yt-dlp --no-playlist --no-warnings -f 'best[height<=480]/best' -o 'reference.%(ext)s' "$REF_URL" >yt-dlp.log 2>&1
YTDLP_RC=$?
set -e
REF_FILE=$(find . -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'reference.*' | head -n1 || true)
if [[ -n "${REF_FILE:-}" ]]; then
  for spec in '00:08:40 ref_area.png' '00:09:50 ref_refine.png' '00:11:40 ref_ftc.png' '00:13:10 ref_geometry.png' '00:16:30 ref_recap.png'; do
    ts=${spec%% *}; out=${spec#* }
    ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -ss "$ts" -i "$REF_FILE" -frames:v 1 "$WORK/refs/$out" || true
  done
  python3 - <<'PYS'
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw
from pathlib import Path
fs=sorted(Path('refs').glob('ref_*.png'))
if fs:
  cards=[]
  for p in fs:
    im=Image.open(p).convert('RGB'); im.thumbnail((480,270)); cards.append((p.name,im.copy()))
  sh=Image.new('RGB',(960,310*((len(cards)+1)//2)),'black'); d=ImageDraw.Draw(sh)
  for i,(n,im) in enumerate(cards):
    x=(i%2)*480;y=(i//2)*310;sh.paste(im,(x,y));d.text((x+8,y+275),n,fill='white')
  sh.save('refs/contact_sheet.jpg',quality=90)
PYS
else
  printf 'yt-dlp rc=%s\n' "$YTDLP_RC" > refs/README.txt
fi
cp yt-dlp.log "$RESULT/"
cp -r refs "$RESULT/reference_qa"

echo '[3/8] source'
printf '%s' '' | base64 -d | gzip -d > integral_scene.py
printf '%s' '' | base64 -d | gzip -d > vo_generate.py
python3 -m py_compile integral_scene.py vo_generate.py

echo '[4/8] Kokoro open-source VO model'
wget -q https://github.com/thewh1teagle/kokoro-onnx/releases/download/model-files-v1.1/kokoro-v1.0.onnx -O kokoro-v1.0.onnx
wget -q https://github.com/thewh1teagle/kokoro-onnx/releases/download/model-files-v1.1/voices-v1.0.bin -O voices-v1.0.bin
python3 vo_generate.py > vo_generation.log

echo '[5/8] actual Manim render'
manim -qm --disable_caching --media_dir media integral_scene.py IntegralExplainer > manim.log 2>&1
VIDEO=$(find media -type f -name 'IntegralExplainer.mp4' | head -n1)
test -s "$VIDEO"
cp "$VIDEO" "$RESULT/integral_3b1b_inspired_v2.mp4"
cp integral_scene.py vo_generate.py vo_timings.json vo_generation.log manim.log "$RESULT/"
mkdir -p "$RESULT/vo"; cp vo/*.wav "$RESULT/vo/"

echo '[6/8] ffprobe'
ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration:stream=codec_name,width,height,r_frame_rate -of json "$RESULT/integral_3b1b_inspired_v2.mp4" > "$RESULT/ffprobe.json"

echo '[7/8] generated-video QA frames'
python3 - <<'PYS'
from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,os
out=Path(os.environ['GITHUB_WORKSPACE'])/'agent-runtime/results/integral-3b1b-v2'
probe=json.loads((out/'ffprobe.json').read_text()); dur=float(probe['format']['duration'])
for i,f in enumerate([.12,.35,.58,.82],1):
 subprocess.run(['ffmpeg','-hide_banner','-loglevel','error','-ss',str(dur*f),'-i',str(out/'integral_3b1b_inspired_v2.mp4'),'-frames:v','1',str(out/f'qa_frame_{i}.jpg')],check=True)
summary={'duration':dur,'yt_dlp_reference_ok':(out/'reference_qa/contact_sheet.jpg').exists(),'video_bytes':(out/'integral_3b1b_inspired_v2.mp4').stat().st_size}
(out/'verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)); print(json.dumps(summary))
PYS

echo '[8/8] complete'
